description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for comparing diff outputs and sanitizing diff data. It specifically handles diff comparison tasks, such as normalizing diff data for comparison purposes by removing variable elements like scores and hashes.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitizing them to ignore variable data like object IDs and scores.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Similar to compare_diff_raw but also transforms null bytes to line feeds before comparison.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two patch files after removing lines related to similarity indices and diff indices.
